targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM whatsapp_messages WHERE direction='outbound' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM whatsapp_messages WHERE direction='inbound' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT AVG(response_time_seconds) as value FROM whatsapp_messages WHERE direction='outbound' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT AVG(satisfaction_score) as value FROM whatsapp_messages WHERE satisfaction_score IS NOT NULL AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as value FROM whatsapp_messages WHERE direction='inbound' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as value FROM whatsapp_messages WHERE direction='outbound' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
